description: This file defines the ManufacturerDao interface, which provides data access methods for Manufacturer entities within the sales manager application. It includes methods for listing manufacturers by store and language, counting attached products, and fetching manufacturers by product categories.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of Manufacturers associated with the given store and language.

methods.name: listByStore (overloaded)
methods.description: Returns a list of Manufacturers associated with the given store.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products attached to the specified Manufacturer.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Returns a list of Manufacturers filtered by store, product categories (by IDs), and language.
